Fields.Name: Motion Blur Enabled
Fields.Description: Turns motion blur on for this level.

Fields.Name: Object Motion Blur Enabled
Fields.Description: Lets moving objects blur, not only camera motion.

Fields.Name: Lower-Resolution Velocity Buffer
Fields.Description: On: the velocity buffer used for the blur is drawn at reduced resolution.

Fields.Name: Cheap Filter Mode
Fields.Description: On: the blur filter is limited to its cheaper mode instead of the full reconstruction filter.

Fields.Name: Sample Count Offset
Fields.Description: Added to the blur sample count; the result is clamped to 2–32 and rounded down to an even number.

Fields.Name: Blur Pass Count Offset
Fields.Description: Added to the number of recursive blur passes; the result is clamped to 1–4.

Fields.Name: Maximum Blur Length Scale
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the maximum blur length.
